import math

OD_RATE = 10.0
COMMIT_RATE = 6.5
HOURS_PER_MONTH = 730
SCENARIOS = [100, 60, 30]

def monthly_costs(utilization_pct):
    hours = HOURS_PER_MONTH * utilization_pct // 100
    od = OD_RATE * hours
    committed = COMMIT_RATE * HOURS_PER_MONTH
    rec = "SAVINGS_PLAN" if committed < od else "ON_DEMAND"
    return od, committed, rec

for u in SCENARIOS:
    od, c, rec = monthly_costs(u)
    print(f"utilization={u}% on_demand={od} committed={c} -> {rec}")

print(f"break_even_hours={math.ceil(COMMIT_RATE * HOURS_PER_MONTH / OD_RATE)}")
